subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt or supersede the open fork PR that still closes this issue before ClawSweeper queues a fresh fix?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the open fork PR is conflicting and unmerged, so automation should not create a duplicate fix until maintainers choose the PR path.

options.title: Supersede fork and queue fresh fix
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then allow a new narrow Control UI fix with localized copy, tests, and visual proof.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor repair the fork branch against the current Debug page structure and review it as the fix path.

recommendation.title: Supersede fork and queue fresh fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then allow a new narrow Control UI fix with localized copy, tests, and visual proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the Debug controller/view surface and has the strongest feature-history signal for deciding the path.
